description: Complete United States Patent Classification (USPC) hierarchy with 132,863 entries covering 471 classes (437 utility, 33 design, 1 plant). Extracted from USPTO class definition PDFs. Provides titles, full definition text, parent-child relationships, and hierarchy depth for each classification symbol. USPC was the primary US patent classification system until 2015 (replaced by CPC for utility patents, still used for design/plant). Use this to look up USPC codes, browse the classification tree, or resolve symbols to human-readable titles. 10 classes (538, 542, 566, 603, 605, 721-724, 984) had no PDFs on USPTO and are not included. 3 classes (532, 968, 976) are wrapper classes with 0 subclasses. PATSTAT note: tls210_appln_n_cls contains ~17,800 records with USPC-like format (XXX/XX), mostly from AT (Austria) and CA (Canada). However, many Austrian codes share the format without being actual USPC — only ~1,100 records resolve against this hierarchy. The table's primary value is as a standalone USPC reference for understanding US patent classification history. JOIN via nat_class_symbol = symbol (canonical) or symbol_patstat (zero-padded).

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Canonical USPC symbol. For classes: '002', 'D14', 'PLT'. For subclasses: '002/1', '002/2.11', 'D14/140'. Primary key.

columns.name: symbol_patstat
columns.description: Zero-padded USPC symbol for potential PATSTAT joins (e.g., '002/001', '002/002.11'). For classes, same as symbol.

columns.name: class_id
columns.description: USPC class identifier: 3-digit zero-padded for utility ('002', '435'), 'D' + 2-digit for design ('D14'), or 'PLT' for plant.

columns.name: subclass_id
columns.description: Subclass number within the class (e.g., '1', '2.11', '140'). NULL for class-level entries.

columns.name: level
columns.description: Numeric hierarchy depth: 0 = class, 1 = top-level subclass, 2+ = nested subclasses. Maximum depth is 15.

columns.name: parent
columns.description: Symbol of the parent node in the hierarchy. Class-level entries have NULL parent. Top-level subclasses reference the class_id. ~4.6% of subclass parents reference intermediate nodes not present as own entries (orphan parents).

columns.name: title
columns.description: Short title or heading from the USPTO definition (e.g., 'APPAREL', 'Astronaut's body cover'). Available for 91.5% of entries.

columns.name: definition
columns.description: Full definition text extracted from the USPTO classification PDF. Contains scope descriptions, notes, and subject matter details. Available for 91% of entries.

columns.name: class_type
columns.description: Type of USPC class: 'utility' (437 classes, 129K subclasses), 'design' (33 classes, 2.6K subclasses), or 'plant' (1 class, 342 subclasses).
